card.name: Linking words before blood pressure or BUN
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces (in, of, lower, under, an opening bracket) right before blood-related lab or vital terms such as blood pressure, blood urea nitrogen and serum creatinine. Seen in ACE inhibitor labels.
